1.text: Umunsi wa Pasika utarasohora, Yesu amenya yuko igihe cye gisohoye cyo kuva mu isi agasubira kuri Se. Urukundo yakunze abe bari mu isi, ni rwo yakomeje kubakunda kugeza imperuka.

2.text: Bakirya ibyokurya bya nijoro, Satani yari yamaze koshya umutima wa Yuda Isikariyota mwene Simoni ngo amugambanire.

3.text: Yesu amenye ko Se amweguriye byose, kandi ko yavuye ku Mana kandi ko asubira kuri yo,

4.text: ahaguruka aho yarīraga yiyambura umwitero, yenda igitambaro aragikenyeza.

5.text: Aherako asuka amazi ku mbehe, atangira koza ibirenge by'abigishwa no kubihanaguza igitambaro akenyeje.

6.text: Nuko yegera Simoni Petero na we aramubaza ati “Databuja, ni wowe unyoza ibirenge?”

7.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Ibyo nkora ubu ntubizi, ariko uzabimenya hanyuma.”

8.text: Petero aramubwira ati “Reka! Ntabwo nzemera na hato ko unyoza ibirenge.”Yesu aramusubiza ati “Nintakōza nta cyo tuzaba duhuriyeho.”

9.text: Simoni Petero aramubwira ati “Databuja, noneho ntunyoze ibirenge byonyine, ahubwo unyuhagire n'amaboko, umese n'umutwe.”

10.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Uwuhagiwe nta kindi agomba keretse kōga ibirenge ngo abe aboneye rwose. Namwe muraboneye, ariko si mwese.”

11.text: Icyatumye avuga ati “Ntimuboneye mwese”, ni uko yari azi uri bumugambanire uwo ari we.

12.text: Nuko amaze kubōza ibirenge yambara imyenda ye, arongera aricara arababaza ati “Aho mumenye icyo mbagiriye?

13.text: Munyita Shobuja n'Umwigisha, ibyo mubivuga neza kuko ari ko ndi koko.

14.text: Nuko rero, ubwo mbogeje ibirenge kandi ndi Shobuja n'Umwigisha, ni ko namwe mukwiriye kubyozanya.

15.text: Mbahaye icyitegererezo, kugira ngo mukore nk'uko mbakoreye.

16.text: Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko umugaragu ataruta shebuja, kandi intumwa itaruta uwayitumye.

18.text: “Simbavuze mwese kuko nzi abo natoranije, keretse ko ibyanditswe bikwiriye gusohora, ngo ‘Urya ibyokurya byanjye ni we umbangiriye umugeri.’

19.text: Dore ubu mbibabwiye bitari byaba, kugira ngo nibiba muzizere ko ndi We.

20.text: Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko umuntu wese wemera Uwantumye ari jye aba yemeye, kandi unyemera aba yemeye n'Uwantumye.”

21.text: Yesu amaze kuvuga atyo, ahagarika umutima arahamya ati “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko umwe muri mwe ari bungambanire.”

22.text: Abigishwa bararebana, kuko batari bazi uwo avuze uwo ari we.

23.text: Hariho umwe mu bigishwa be, wari wiseguye igituza cya Yesu bafungura. Uwo ni wa wundi Yesu yakundaga.

24.text: Simoni Petero aramurembuza aramubaza ati “Umubaze uwo avuze uwo ari we.”

25.text: Uwo ahengamira inyuma aho yari ari mu gituza cya Yesu, aramubaza ati “Databuja, ni nde?”

26.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Uwo ndi bukoreze inogo nkayimuha, ni we uwo.” Nuko akojeje inogo, arayenda ayiha Yuda Isikariyota mwene Simoni.

27.text: Hanyuma yo guhabwa iyo nogo, ni bwo Satani yamwinjiyemo. Nuko Yesu aramubwira ati “Icyo ukora gikore vuba.”

28.text: Ariko nta n'umwe wo mu bari bicaye basangira na we, wamenye icyatumye amubwira atyo.

29.text: Kuko Yuda yari afite umufuka w'impiya, ni cyo cyatumye bamwe bakeka yuko Yesu yamubwiye ati “Genda ugure ibyo dushaka kurya ku munsi mukuru”, cyangwa ati “Gira icyo uha abakene.”

30.text: Nuko Yuda amaze kwakira inogo, muri ako kanya arasohoka kandi hari nijoro.

31.text: Amaze gusohoka Yesu aravuga ati “Noneho Umwana w'umuntu arubahirijwe, kandi Imana na yo yubahirijwe muri we.

32.text: Kandi Imana ubwo yubahirijwe muri we, na yo izamwubahiriza muri yo ubwayo, kandi izamwubahiriza vuba.

33.text: Bana bato, ndacyari hamwe namwe umwanya muto. Muzanshaka, kandi uko nabwiye Abayuda nti ‘Aho njya ntimubasha kuhajya’, namwe ni ko mbibabwira ubu.

34.text: Ndabaha itegeko rishya ngo mukundane nk'uko nabakunze, mube ari ko namwe mukundana.

35.text: Ibyo ni byo bose bazabamenyeraho ko muri abigishwa banjye, nimukundana.”

36.text: Simoni Petero aramubaza ati “Databuja, urajya he?”Yesu aramusubiza ati “Aho njya ntubasha kunkurikira ubu, ariko uzahankurikira hanyuma.”

37.text: Petero aramusubiza ati “Databuja, icyambuza kugukurikira ubu ni ik, ko nzanagupfira?”

38.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Uzampfira? Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndakubwira yuko inkoko itaza kubika, utaranyihakana gatatu.
